ai.intro: Ask for suggestions, review each action, and confirm only the changes you want. You can leave this page at any time.
ai.setupHint: Run Ollama on this computer with a locally installed model and cloud features disabled (OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1). Enter the model name and port, then save. The assistant only connects to 127.0.0.1.
ai.request: What would you like help with?
ai.requestPlaceholder: Help me plan my tasks, suggest tags, or schedule a reminder…
ai.contextHint: Generating shares up to 200 tasks and 100 tags with your local model. Application history and window titles are excluded. Nothing changes until you confirm an action.
ai.backgroundHint: The local model is working. You can keep using the app and return here later.
ai.empty: Generate suggestions when you want assistance. Pending suggestions stay here until you review them.
ai.noSuggestions: There are no pending suggestions. You can ask for something more specific.
ai.editHint: Saving updates the suggestion only. Review the saved preview, then confirm it separately.
ai.alarmHint: A one-off reminder at the next occurrence of this local time. It uses your alarm defaults.
ai.clearHint: Clear all AI operation history? Tasks, tags, reminders and pending suggestions are kept.

error.IO: Could not reach the local model. Check that Ollama is running, the model is installed and the port is correct, then retry.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid settings, fields or model response. Check your input or try generating again.
error.NOT_FOUND: A referenced task or tag no longer exists. Edit the suggestion or reject it.
error.CONFLICT: The suggestion or its target changed, a tag name is in use, or too many proposals are pending. Review the current preview, edit it or reject it before retrying.
error.DATABASE: The operation could not be saved. No partial action was applied; please retry.
error.UNSUPPORTED: AI assistance is available in the desktop app.
error.INTERNAL: The operation could not finish. Refresh and retry.
